verified_facts.text: PGA Frisco is a public/private partnership between the PGA of America, Omni Hotels & Resorts, the City of Frisco and the Frisco Independent School District.
verified_facts.excerpt: PGA Frisco is a public/private partnership between the PGA of America, Omni Hotels & Resorts, the City of Frisco and the Frisco Independent School District.

verified_facts.text: The resort sits on the 660-acre PGA Frisco campus, which also includes Fields Ranch, The PGA District, PGA of America and Northern Texas PGA.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 660-acre campus is a unique destination that includes Fields Ranch, Omni PGA Frisco Resort & Spa, The PGA District, PGA of America, and Northern Texas PGA.

verified_facts.text: Omni PGA Frisco Resort & Spa features two championship golf courses, a full-service spa and four pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Omni PGA Frisco Resort & Spa features 2 championship golf courses, full-service spa, 4 pools & 13 restaurants & bars.

verified_facts.text: Fields Ranch East is a Gil Hanse-designed course offering a strategic challenge.
verified_facts.excerpt: A Gil Hanse-designed course offering a compelling strategic challenge.

verified_facts.text: Fields Ranch West is a Beau Welling-designed course encouraging shotmaking and creativity.
verified_facts.excerpt: A Beau Welling-designed course encouraging shotmaking and creativity.

verified_facts.text: The Dance Floor is a lighted two-acre putting course co-designed by Gil Hanse and Beau Welling.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lighted 2-acre putting course co-designed by Gil Hanse and Beau Welling.

verified_facts.text: The Swing is a lighted 10-hole, par-3 short course for golfers of all skill levels.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lighted 10-hole, par-3 short course is for golfers of all skill levels.

verified_facts.text: PGA Frisco is the home of the 2027 PGA Championship.
verified_facts.excerpt: Home of the 2027 PGA Championship

verified_facts.text: The Ranch House Villas are four-bedroom villas designed as a modern take on the Texas ranch home.
verified_facts.excerpt: A modern take on the Texas ranch home, 10 spacious four-bedroom villas are perfect for a golf or family getaway.

verified_facts.text: The Ranch House Villas have chef kitchens, outdoor patios with fire pits and interiors filled with natural light.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy chef kitchens, outdoor patios with fire pits, 4.5 bathrooms and expansive interiors filled with natural light.

verified_facts.text: Mokara Spa includes a sauna, a steam room and a private pool for spa guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: An oasis of wellness, this rejuvenating spa includes 20 private treatment rooms, a sauna, steam room, a private pool for spa guests, and a relaxing café.

verified_facts.text: The Leisure Pool Bar sits next to two pools and a splash pad.
verified_facts.excerpt: A pool bar with pool-friendly handhelds, big salads, chilled sweet treats and vibrant pool mixology to elevate your day next to two pools and a splash pad.

verified_facts.text: Trick Rider is a Texas-style supper club specializing in steaks and seafood.
verified_facts.excerpt: A Texas-style supper club paying homage to traditions with a modern twist, specializing in signature steaks and seafood dishes.

verified_facts.text: Trick Rider's horseshoe-shaped bar sits under Cinnamon, a Swarovski crystal horse chandelier.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a cocktail at the horseshoe-shaped bar, under the glimmer of Cinnamon, a Swarovski crystal horse chandelier.

verified_facts.text: The Apron is a casual restaurant in the resort serving Texas and California fare with views of Fields Ranch.
verified_facts.excerpt: A casual restaurant in the resort serving creative Texas and California fare with spectacular views of Fields Ranch.

verified_facts.text: Ice House is a ranch-style venue with BBQ from the pit and six live hitting bays.
verified_facts.excerpt: A ranch-style venue serving cold beer and cocktails along with hearty BBQ from the pit for hungry golfers. Features six live hitting bays and stunning fairway views.

verified_facts.text: Lounge by Topgolf has Swing Suites powered by Full Swing technology.
verified_facts.excerpt: Chef-driven dishes, craft cocktails and Swing Suites powered by Full Swing technology.

verified_facts.text: The Collective Green shop in the resort lobby carries brands such as Peter Millar, Greyson, Vuori and Holderness & Bourne.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the lobby of the resort, featuring styles from top brands like Peter Millar, Greyson, Vuori, and Holderness & Bourne.

verified_facts.text: Green Cactus Cafe at Mokara Spa serves wellness-driven foods including light bites, juices and elixirs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treat your whole mind, body, and spirit with wellness-driven foods including lite bites, healthy juices, elixirs, and sweet treats at our relaxing café at Mokara Spa.

verified_facts.text: The PGA of America plans to bring dozens of spectator and amateur championships to PGA Frisco in the coming years.
verified_facts.excerpt: The PGA of America is proud to bring dozens of Spectator and Amateur Championships to PGA Frisco in the coming years.
